label: Run 1: first battle test (before fixes)
scope: Local only: private regtest nodes on 127.0.0.1. Network-flood tests are out of scope.

tests.name: Valid control block with a 4-input, 400-output transaction
tests.attack: control case (not an attack): a valid block with one signature covering four same-key inputs
tests.expected: accept

tests.name: Coinbase pays 1 lamina too much (inflation)
tests.attack: miner creates money: coinbase = subsidy + fees + 1
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Coinbase pays 1,000 VARV extra
tests.attack: miner creates 1,000 VARV out of thin air
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Header commits to the wrong transaction root
tests.attack: valid PoW, but the merkle root does not match the transactions
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: invalid: bad transaction root; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Same coin spent twice in one block
tests.attack: two transactions in one block spend the same coin
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Transaction lists the same input twice
tests.attack: one transaction spends one coin twice to double its value
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Spend of a coin that never existed
tests.attack: transaction spends an outpoint that is not in the UTXO set
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Spend of an immature coinbase
tests.attack: spends a block reward before the 288-block maturity
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Transaction with a corrupted signature
tests.attack: one bit of the ML-DSA signature flipped
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Thief signs someone else's coin with their own key
tests.attack: valid signature by the attacker's key on a coin locked to the victim's key
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Shared witness with no earlier signature
tests.attack: uses the one-signature-for-many-coins witness without any signature before it
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Shared witness used to steal another key's coin
tests.attack: attacker signs their own coin and attaches a victim's coin with an empty shared witness
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Unknown witness path
tests.attack: witness path 3, which no rule defines
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: parse error: unknown witness path; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Block over the 720,000 weight limit
tests.attack: a block stuffed past the weight limit with a 5,100-output transaction
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Timestamp one hour in the future
tests.attack: header timestamp 3,600 s ahead (limit: 600 s)
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: timestamp too far in the future (deferred); p2p: still connected

tests.name: Timestamp not above median time past
tests.attack: timestamp equal to the median of the last 11 blocks (time-warp building block)
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: invalid: timestamp not above median time past; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Block claims an easier difficulty
tests.attack: header target 64x easier than the schedule allows
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: invalid: wrong target; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Block without valid proof of work
tests.attack: nonce that does not meet the target
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: invalid: insufficient proof of work; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Second coinbase transaction
tests.attack: a block with two reward transactions
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Block with no transactions at all
tests.attack: a valid-PoW header followed by an empty transaction list
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: Some("parse error: empty block")

tests.name: Coinbase not in first position
tests.attack: a normal transaction placed before the coinbase
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Coinbase commits to the wrong height
tests.attack: coinbase input index differs from the block height (duplicate-txid risk)
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Coinbase extra data over 64 bytes
tests.attack: 65 bytes of coinbase extra data
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Transaction spends more than its inputs
tests.attack: outputs exceed inputs by 1 lamina
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Output sum overflow
tests.attack: two outputs of MAX_MONEY each
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Output locked to an unknown signature scheme
tests.attack: creates an output with scheme id 3
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Transaction locked until a future height
tests.attack: locktime 100 blocks ahead
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Recovery key used before its delay
tests.attack: recovery-path spend 999 blocks too early
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: rejected: invalid: block failed validation; p2p: peer disconnected us

tests.name: Valid-looking block built on an invalid parent
tests.attack: submits an inflating block, then a well-formed child on top of it
tests.expected: reject both; never build on the invalid branch
tests.detail: parent: Err("invalid: block failed validation"); child: Err("invalid: invalid: parent is invalid")

tests.name: Mutated copy of a real block sent first
tests.attack: announces a real header, sends a body that does not match it, then the real block arrives
tests.expected: reject the mutated body without marking the real block invalid; accept the real block
tests.detail: real block after mutated copy: Ok(()); tip is the real block: true

tests.name: Same key signed twice instead of the shared form
tests.attack: a relayer re-encodes a transaction's witnesses so its witness id and size change (witness malleability)
tests.expected: reject the block and keep the current tip
tests.detail: node ACCEPTED the invalid block (rpc: Ok(()), tip now bef5ed51813fa5bc)

tests.name: Double spend by a longer private chain
tests.attack: pays the node's wallet in a public block, then publishes a longer private chain that sends the same coin back to the attacker
tests.expected: follow the most-work chain, drop the conflicting payment, and reflect the reversal in the wallet balance
tests.detail: public block: Ok(()); switched to private chain: true; reversed payment left in mempool: false; balance before 100.00000000 / after payment {"addresses":["rvarve1pqqqsq78yyfht85tps35t49uvj2jta7tcw2huvyax0mkrmjjt5wzvu5krehl5gc","rvarve1pqqqsq470pggctvwx68h5skm3wxkhxzu0trqvyg09lc02u9y6ykms932nyjjyan","rvarve1pqqqsprwphs5xpx2f9w4glzh4989uvteyt9vqjh9ejhycrfr6zmmhw3yazjqdtn"],"immature":"0.00000000","keys":3,"spendable":"100.28487500","utxos":21} / after reorg {"addresses":["rvarve1pqqqsq78yyfht85tps35t49uvj2jta7tcw2huvyax0mkrmjjt5wzvu5krehl5gc","rvarve1pqqqsq470pggctvwx68h5skm3wxkhxzu0trqvyg09lc02u9y6ykms932nyjjyan","rvarve1pqqqsprwphs5xpx2f9w4glzh4989uvteyt9vqjh9ejhycrfr6zmmhw3yazjqdtn"],"immature":"0.00000000","keys":3,"spendable":"100.00000000","utxos":20}; p2p: still connected

tests.name: Competing block with equal work
tests.attack: a second block at the same height arrives after the first
tests.expected: keep the first-seen block (no flip-flopping on ties)
tests.detail: first: Ok(()); second: Ok(())

tests.name: Longer chain (22 blocks) with an invalid block inside
tests.attack: publishes a chain with more work than the node's, whose 4th block inflates the supply
tests.expected: stay on the valid chain
tests.detail: tip unchanged: true

tests.name: Deep reorganization (20 blocks replaced)
tests.attack: publishes a valid chain one block longer than the node's last 20 blocks
tests.expected: switch to the most-work chain cleanly and quickly
tests.detail: switched: true in 2.7 s

tests.name: Conflicting transaction after the first
tests.attack: two transactions spending the same coin, the second paying a higher fee
tests.expected: accept the first, refuse the conflict
tests.detail: first true, second Err("conflicts with a mempool transaction (no replacement)")

tests.name: Zero-fee transaction
tests.attack: a valid transaction that pays no fee
tests.expected: refuse to relay (minimum relay fee)
tests.detail: Err("fee 0 below minimum relay fee 5456")

tests.name: Long chain of unconfirmed transactions
tests.attack: 40 transactions each spending the previous one before any confirms
tests.expected: cap the chain (ancestor limit) instead of growing without bound
tests.detail: accepted 26; stopped at 26: too many unconfirmed ancestors (policy)

tests.name: 2000 randomly mutated blocks and transactions (RPC)
tests.attack: bit flips, random bytes, truncation and insertion applied to a valid block and transaction
tests.expected: reject every malformed input without crashing
tests.detail: crashes 0, mutated blocks accepted 0

tests.name: 200000 random messages through the message decoder
tests.attack: random bytes decoded as every one of the 14 message types, in process
tests.expected: return an error for malformed input, never panic
tests.detail: panics: 0; random inputs that happened to decode: 470

tests.name: Two independent implementations agree on 3,000 mutated transactions
tests.attack: randomly mutated transactions checked by the Rust node and by the separate Python reference implementation
tests.expected: both implementations reach the same verdict on every input (a disagreement could split the chain)
tests.detail: disagreements: 0; node vs its own library: 0; inputs that still parsed: 755

tests.name: Malformed address
tests.attack: sendtoaddress with malformed address
tests.expected: refuse with a clear error
tests.detail: refused: no separator

tests.name: Address from another network
tests.attack: sendtoaddress with address from another network
tests.expected: refuse with a clear error
tests.detail: refused: address is for a different network

tests.name: Zero amount
tests.attack: sendtoaddress with zero amount
tests.expected: refuse with a clear error
tests.detail: refused: amount out of range

tests.name: Negative amount
tests.attack: sendtoaddress with negative amount
tests.expected: refuse with a clear error
tests.detail: refused: bad amount -5

tests.name: Nine decimal places
tests.attack: sendtoaddress with nine decimal places
tests.expected: refuse with a clear error
tests.detail: refused: bad amount 1.000000001

tests.name: Amount above total supply
tests.attack: sendtoaddress with amount above total supply
tests.expected: refuse with a clear error
tests.detail: refused: amount out of range

tests.name: More than the wallet holds
tests.attack: sendtoaddress with more than the wallet holds
tests.expected: refuse with a clear error
tests.detail: refused: insufficient spendable funds: have 10000000000 laminae

tests.name: Non-numeric amount
tests.attack: sendtoaddress with non-numeric amount
tests.expected: refuse with a clear error
tests.detail: refused: bad amount 1e3

tests.name: Twelve payments sent at the same moment
tests.attack: 12 simultaneous sendtoaddress calls from one wallet
tests.expected: every accepted payment is valid (no coin spent twice)
tests.detail: 12 accepted, 0 accepted-but-invalid; errors: []

tests.name: Block file cut off mid-record
tests.attack: the last 777 bytes of the block file are removed (power loss)
tests.expected: come back up and re-sync to the honest chain
tests.detail: restarted at height 347 (source tip 348); back in sync with the network: True

tests.name: Random bytes appended to the block file
tests.attack: 5,000 random bytes appended
tests.expected: come back up and re-sync to the honest chain
tests.detail: restarted at height 348 (source tip 348); back in sync with the network: True

tests.name: Block file corrupted in the middle
tests.attack: 64 random bytes written over the middle of the block file
tests.expected: come back up and re-sync to the honest chain
tests.detail: restarted at height 347 (source tip 348); back in sync with the network: False

tests.name: Block file deleted
tests.attack: the whole block file is removed
tests.expected: come back up and re-sync to the honest chain
tests.detail: restarted at height 3 (source tip 348); back in sync with the network: True

tests.name: Power cut during initial sync
tests.attack: process killed with SIGKILL at height 348 while syncing
tests.expected: come back up and re-sync to the honest chain
tests.detail: restarted at height 348 (source tip 348); back in sync with the network: True

tests.name: Power cut while mining
tests.attack: mining node killed with SIGKILL mid-work, then restarted
tests.expected: restart with its chain intact and keep mining
tests.detail: killed at height 16; restarted at 16; kept mining: True
